name: monash-plugin
description: Monash plugin. Its Python unittest suite and syntax and compile check are qualified on Python 3.11 and run through python3.11, not whichever python3 is first on PATH.

scripts.typecheck: python3.11 -B -c "import pathlib; root = pathlib.Path('scripts/foundry'); files = sorted(p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_file() and (p.suffix == '.py' or (p.suffix == '' and b'python' in b''.join(p.read_bytes().splitlines()[:1])))); [compile(p.read_bytes(), str(p), 'exec') for p in files]; print('compiled', len(files), 'Python files with Python 3.11: a syntax and compile check only, not static typing')"
